embedding_source: normalized Laplacian eigenvectors of a state-transition graph constructed from the five seen operations; MUL held out from embedding construction
interpretation: Transition-topology spectral geometry is not automatically fusion-safe. In actual source fusion, 8D degrades heavily and 16D remains materially below the explicit action-probability baseline; 24D approaches but does not exactly match it. This contrasts with the hand-coded binary5 and fusion-law-trained learned6 geometries.
claim_boundary: The graph construction uses externally identified common states and seen-operation transitions, so this is not label-free discovery. Spectral embeddings are deterministic topology features, not jointly learned source adapters.
